status_definitions.open: No complete, current exit-criteria proof is recorded.
status_definitions.partial: Remediation or focused proof exists, but one or more exit criteria remain unproven.
status_definitions.closed: Every exit criterion has externally attested command and closure evidence bound to the current commit and release.
status_definitions.reopened: Previously closed evidence became invalid, stale, regressed, or was superseded.

status_derivation.open: No valid independent remediation evidence is bound to the criterion.
status_derivation.partial: At least one fresh, digest-valid, non-control remediation artifact exists, but closure requirements are not all satisfied.
status_derivation.closed: The fail-closed authority policy is enabled; acceptance passed; any applicable command has a trusted retained result; current closure attestation, commit, and release artifact bindings all match; and remaining_work is empty.
status_derivation.reopened: A previously closed criterion no longer derives closed.
status_derivation.gap_aggregation: reopened wins; otherwise all closed => closed; any partial or closed => partial; otherwise open.

closure_authority_policy.reason: No cryptographically verified commit/release attestation is bound in this worktree ledger.

command_attestation_policy.reason: No cryptographically verified command attestation is bound in this worktree ledger.
